name: The Last Shadow
summary: Darkvision 120 ft, Advantage on Stealth, and Darkness a few times a day. The price: vulnerability to radiant damage.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: The dark takes you in like family. You can call it into a room and walk through it unseen.

cost.flaw: Candles gutter as you pass, and your shadow follows a little late, as if it had to be persuaded.
cost.text: You belong to the dark now, and light treats you as a trespasser: holy fire and sunlight cut you to the bone.
